Mirrorify : Lock Screen Camera Mirror
Mirrorify lets you check your appearance instantly, right from your lock screen. Simply long-press the floating bubble to bring up a smooth, circular front-camera mirror—no unlocking, no switching apps, just a quick and effortless glance whenever you need it.

KEY FEATURES
• Lock-screen camera overlay for quick appearance checks
• Long-press bubble to show/hide the mirror instantly
• Adjustable preview size, corner radius, and position
• Uses the front camera only; no photos or videos are saved
• Works offline; fast and discreet

🎯 PERFECT FOR
• People who care about their appearance and beauty
• Quick touch-ups before meetings, photos, or video calls
• Last-minute checks without unlocking

⚙️ HOW IT WORKS
1) Grant camera permission when prompted
2) Enable the Mirrorify accessibility service in Settings
3) Long-press the floating bubble on the lock screen to show the mirror
4) Release to hide instantly

🔒 PRIVACY & SECURITY
•  Camera feed is not recorded, stored, or shared
•  No data collection or tracking
•  Works completely offline

📣 ACCESSIBILITY SERVICE DISCLOSURE
• Mirrorify uses an AccessibilityService to display a floating bubble and circular camera overlay on top of the lock screen when you long-press the bubble.
• The service is used only for this overlay functionality and does not change device settings, capture device audio, or control navigation.
• Mirrorify is not an accessibility tool for people with disabilities and does not use the  IsAccessibilityTool flag.
• The service can be disabled at any time in system Settings.

💡 TIPS
• Customize the overlay size and position in the preview screen
• Adjust corner radius for your preferred look
• The floating button appears after enabling the service

Transform your lock screen into a convenient mirror with Mirrorify—instant selfie checks without unlocking.
